title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
summary: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.

title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Wake Up After 16 Years, Moving $6.9 Million
summary: Two Bitcoin mining rewards from September 2010 moved minutes apart. The coins are worth nearly 1.15 million times their original market value.

title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
